name: Shadowflame Forge ranks 1 and 2 lengthen Hellmaw by 3 and 6 seconds (#1334)
contract: #1334 claims Shadowflame Forge 704989/707838 has no server handler. Live client Spell.dbc: both ranks (family 23, CharacterAdvancement 34099, class 17 Hellfire tab) read 'Increases the duration of Hellmaw by $/1000;s1 sec'. Effect 0 is the native aura 107 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER), MiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), BasePoints 2999/5999 + DieSides 1 = +3000/+6000 ms, class mask (0x40, 0, 0), which is exactly the family flags of every Hellmaw rank (806965-806970, 573336). Hellmaw's DurationIndex 29 is 12000 ms. Nothing in AscensionXorothContracts.cpp touches either rank and xoroth_casts::OnCalcMaxDuration leaves Hellmaw alone, so Aura::CalcMaxDuration applies SPELLMOD_DURATION natively. Expected: an untalented Hellmaw lasts 12 s, with rank 1 15 s, with rank 2 (rank 1 removed) 18 s. Each cast hits its own Harvest Golem so no refresh is involved; melee hit and expertise ratings remove the miss, dodge and parry rolls of this melee-class spell. Effect 2 (aura 108, SPELLMOD_DOT +25% on the same mask) is data the tooltip does not describe and is not asserted here. No gameplay change: this is evidence against the report's premise.
